findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "I DON'T JUST USE SYSTEMS. I LEARN HOW THEY FAIL." → 4 lines (10 words, 46px); "ASSUME NOTHING. VERIFY EVERYTHING. REDUCE THE AT" → 7 lines (18 words, 72px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 13 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "CYBERSECURITY // PERSONAL SECURITY PROFILE" above "HOLY"; "01 // WHO IS HOLY?" above "SECURITY IS A MINDSET."; "IDENTITY CARD // SIMULATION" above "HOLY"; "02 // SECURITY CREDENTIALS" above "THE CERTIFICATION ROADMAP"; "03 // EXPERIENCE" above "INDUSTRY EXPOSURE"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace — e.g. "HOLY // SECURE ENTRY — SIMULATION", "$ initiating secure channel…[+] handshak", "CLEARANCE CODE", "(anything works — it's theater)"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "03", "04", "05", "06"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 190 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "HOLY // SECURE ENTRY — SIMULATION", "CLEARANCE CODE", "CYBERSECURITY // PERSONAL SECURITY PROFI", "OPEN TO:").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ✓ ★ ⚡ ⛉ ⚠
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 54 gradient fill(s): div.bg-grid → linear-gradient(rgba(255, 51, 85, 0.043) 1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 51, 85,  | div.bg-glow → radial-gradient(600px 320px at 15% 0%, rgba(255, 51, 85, 0.09), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 60%), radial-gradient(700px 3 | div.tele → linear-gradient(rgb(21, 28, 36), rgb(16, 22, 29))
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 4 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.tele → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5) 0px 30px 80px 0px | figure.op-photo.ultra-frame → rgba(252, 50, 84, 0.25) 0px 30px 94.92px 0px | article.card.cred → rgba(255, 176, 32, 0.004) 0px 0px 0.684533px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 29 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): nav.nav 1440px | div.tele-head 545px | div.tele-metrics 545px | div.tele-foot 545px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 60 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 6 dashed/dotted border(s).
findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: 2 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 8 rows of identical boxed cards.
findings.fix: Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (Inter, JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace).
findings.fix: Two at most.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (5.5:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: Only 2 picture(s) on the page (2 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 828 characters per line.
findings.fix: Cap paragraphs at 45–75 characters (max-width: 60ch).

findings.message: 241 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The title is not readable 1.2s after the page loaded (something lies over it).
findings.fix: Put the headline in the HTML, painted on the first frame; the load sequence only adds arrival and is settled by 1.2s (references/motion.md, "Load sequence in 1.2 seconds"). No preloader, no gate, no waiting for the load event.

findings.message: 6 sections keep all their content on one side and leave 52% of the width empty: "HOLY // SOC" (right 727px empty); "AUTHORIZED" (right 746px empty); "REPORTS &" (right 739px empty); "CURRENTLY" (right 718px empty)
findings.fix: Use the whole width the page has set up: put the section's picture, its second column, its list or its figure in the empty half, or set the text larger across the grid. Empty space must be placed, with something on each side of it.

findings.message: 6 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 788px at 11232px; 1376px at 12272px; 748px at 14676px; 1704px at 15652px (the screen is 900px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("HOLY") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "I DON'T JUST USE SYSTEMS. I LEARN HOW THEY FAIL." (screen 1, 100% hidden); "HOW THEY FAIL." (screen 1, 100% hidden); "HOLY // SECURITY TELEMETRY" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "SECURITY IS A MINDSET." (screen 3, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 768px: "I DON'T JUST USE SYSTEMS. I LEARN HOW THEY FAIL." → 3 lines (10 words, 33.8px); "ASSUME NOTHING. VERIFY EVERYTHING. REDUCE THE AT" → 7 lines (18 words, 46.1px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 32px or less.

findings.message: 8 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "CYBERSECURITY // PERSONAL SECU" (15px from the left); "I DON'T JUST USE SYSTEMS." (0px from the left); "I LEARN" (0px from the left); "HOW THEY FAIL." (0px from the left)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "I DON'T JUST USE SYSTEMS. I LEARN HOW THEY FAIL." → 3 lines (10 words, 26px); "Quizzes, toolkit, challenges & your dashboard li" → 3 lines (9 words, 22px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: The page sits off-centre: its content comes to 16px from the left edge but only to 144px from the right, at 390px.
findings.fix: Give the page one pair of equal margins. Check the wrapper for a max-width without margin-inline: auto, a grid with an empty last column, or padding on one side only. If one side is meant to hold air, it must still be closed by something that reaches the margin (a picture, the navigation's last item, a figure).
